# Phonon-2 (transcribers/phonon.py), installed by services/phonon_install.py into
# <data_dir>/phonon/venv, never into the backend's environment. Exact versions of every package
# as checked on 2026-10-08 (AMI benchmark, code review of fermion-research 0.2.11), each with the
# SHA-256 of every file the index lists for it; the install runs with --require-hashes, so a file
# that differs (a tampered mirror, a re-uploaded release) is refused. torch is the CPU build,
# installed first, alone, from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu.
#
# Regenerate (from the pins alone, one name==version per line) with:
#   uv pip compile pins.in --generate-hashes --python-version 3.13 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --index-url https://pypi.org/simple \
#     --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
#     --no-header --no-annotate -o phonon-requirements.txt
# and check that the package list did not grow (every dependency must be in the file).
